svg.title: Game development — Staggered spread
svg.desc: Four project contributions: object pooling, AI integration, skill tree, and development leadership. Embedded real project screenshots.

g.text: I prewarm and reuse enemies, projectiles
and effects through a shared object pool.
On checkout, each instance resets its state;
on return, it is deactivated and stored for
reuse. The same lifecycle keeps frequent
Player requests become structured game operations. Unity checks the source
text, known skills, targets and costs before spending points and executing the
plan. The companion then reports the result, connecting a conversational
request to a visible action on the battlefield.
Players spend kill points to expand the rings, strengthen turrets and unlock zone effects.
As team captain and lead programmer, I coordinated
Git contributions and divided the work into clear
tasks. I exposed gameplay and visual settings
through configuration assets and prefabs, so artists
could tune the game without changing its core logic.
